read_when: you deploy to Tarnwell or change its settings

02ac912c.text: Tarnwell stores secrets per app, and a copied app starts with none of them set.

071af9ee.text: A Tarnwell deploy keeps the previous image for one day only, so a late rollback needs a rebuild.

0e1efbc5.text: Tarnwell treats a trailing slash in a domain entry as a different domain from the same name without one.

0ed90efb.text: Tarnwell scales to zero after an hour idle on the small plan, which makes the first request slow.

167de09d.text: Tarnwell build logs are cut at two megabytes, which hides the real error in a noisy install step.

1dd7e3d2.text: Tarnwell environment values with a dollar sign are expanded at start, so escape them in the template.

26f23934.text: Tarnwell reports a deploy as finished once the container starts, before the health probe has passed.

46ba8090.text: Tarnwell cron entries run in UTC whatever the host clock says, so convert local times first.

4e3f9c56.text: Tarnwell reads the template when you upload it, so edits made afterwards never reach the running app.

4ef9f2da.text: Tarnwell caps an upload at fifty megabytes; larger bundles need the registry route instead.

57db4043.text: Tarnwell mounts persistent folders read-only during a rollback, so an app that writes there crashes.

668b3d16.text: Tarnwell shows the last deploy time in local time but stores it in UTC, which confuses audits.

6ddd6171.text: Tarnwell lets two apps claim one domain and serves whichever deployed last.

70c2ed39.text: Tarnwell keeps one build running per project, so a second push waits instead of replacing the first.

746f7533.text: Tarnwell rejects an app name with capital letters, but the error it prints blames the template.

77e8dced.text: Tarnwell templates cannot include another template, so shared settings must be pasted into each one.

80b217f0.text: Tarnwell injects the port through an environment variable; an app that hard-codes a port never answers.

96895088.text: Tarnwell health probes use the root path, so a login redirect there marks a healthy app as down.

97655ba1.text: Tarnwell resolves an internal service name only inside the same project, never across projects.

9c1cae54.text: Tarnwell disk quotas count old images, so a full disk usually means stale builds, not data.

a24b67b2.text: Tarnwell rotates its logs at midnight UTC, so a deploy near midnight splits its output across two files.

b19301f8.text: Tarnwell backups skip folders that are not marked persistent, even when the app writes there daily.

c727d6b4.text: Tarnwell restarts every app on a plan change, including apps that were stopped on purpose.

ccdcd4bd.text: Tarnwell ignores a dotfile named in the template unless the build step copies it explicitly.

ebd7dd2a.text: Tarnwell webhooks retry three times and then give up silently, so check the delivery log by hand.

f07132e8.text: Tarnwell shows memory in mebibytes on the dashboard but takes megabytes in the template.
